caption: Perfect time ka wait mat karo. Chhota start bhi start hota hai.\n\nAaj ek small action lo. Kal ke confidence ka base aaj ka action hota hai.

slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Perfect plan ka wait karte karte bahut saare sapne sirf sapne hi reh jaate hain.
Thoda aur soch leta hoon. Thoda aur time dekh leta hoon. Abhi sahi time nahi hai.
Life kabhi 100% ready nahi hoti. Jo wait karte rehte hain, wo aksar shuru hi nahi kar pate.
Sochne se cheeze clear nahi hoti, karne se hoti hain. Shuru karoge to raste khud bante jaayenge.
Ek chhota goal likho. Sirf 10 minute se shuru karo. Progress ko track karo.
Shuru karo. Consistency rakho. Apna best dete raho. Wahi kaafi hai.
slides.note: A better you is a brighter tomorrow.
